patient._comment: 'patient' is info about the patient: personal, clinical, vitals are shown on the patient card during the game; diagnosis is used for potential 'patient review' card.

clinical.chiefComplaint: Back from Africa with a cold
clinical.quoteLong: I did the gorilla trek — bucket list, unbelievable. Now I've got a stuffy nose, and my girlfriend googled Ebola, and so here we are.
clinical.presentationShort: 29yo M — returned from a Congo tourist trek 9 days ago. No ill contacts, no funerals, no bushmeat. Afebrile, clear coryza.
clinical.presentationLong: 29-year-old male returned nine days ago from a Congo tourist trek with no contact with ill persons, funerals or bushmeat; afebrile with straightforward coryza.

diagnosis.primary: Common cold in a returning traveller with no epidemiological risk
diagnosis.esi2roomsNotes: ESI 5: no ED treatment-area resources are expected; brief evaluation, counseling, and discharge are appropriate.
diagnosis.disposition: Discharge → symptomatic care and standard returning-traveller precautions
diagnosis.why: Same country, opposite answer. Exposure history is what matters: no sick contacts, no funeral, no fever. Geography alone is not risk.

answer._comment: 'answer' is answer for the game scoring.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
aiImageGeneration.who: a white 29-year-old man in a safari-style shirt with a camera strap around his neck, seated on a blue padded clinic chair
aiImageGeneration.pose: sitting back comfortably, one arm draped over the chair back
aiImageGeneration.lookSeverity: completely well apart from an obvious head cold
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character. Match the painterly STYLE of the attached reference image - its brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting and palette - but do NOT copy its cropping, camera distance or composition. FRAMING (follow exactly): a full-body WIDE SHOT, square 1:1, 3/4 front view, subject centred. The ENTIRE figure must be inside the frame from the top of the head to the soles of both feet, and the ENTIRE chair must be inside the frame including all four chair legs meeting the floor. Leave clear empty margin on all four sides - roughly 10% of the image width as space above the head and below the feet. This is NOT a close-up, NOT a bust, NOT a head-and-shoulders portrait, NOT a cropped view: the camera is pulled well back so the whole person and the whole chair sit comfortably inside the picture with room around them. Draw the COMPLETE body - head, neck, torso, both arms, both hands, lap, both legs, both feet with shoes. Nothing cropped by the edges, no missing or truncated limbs, no body part fading out or left unfinished. Subject: a white 29-year-old man in a safari-style shirt with a camera strap around his neck, seated on a blue padded clinic chair. Pose: sitting back comfortably, one arm draped over the chair back. Expression: cheerful and entirely unbothered. Clearly visible: a red rimmed nose; a tissue in one hand; sun-tanned face. Overall: completely well apart from an obvious head cold. No text, no logos, no watermarks, no border.
